_comment: Old (Drona < 2.0) runtime_support paths and where their files live now. Used by drona_runtime_paths.resolve() for $ref, $include and retriever lookups when a path does not exist. Candidates are tried in order. Remove at DRONA_ENV_API 2.1. driver_scripts/drona_wf_driver_sbatch is a symlink instead, because environment drivers run it from the shell.
